q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
web/src/connect.ts
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
store/memo.go
store/driver.go
store/db/sqlite/memo.go
```

How each hop connects:

- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — `useCreateMemo()` (line 178) is the TanStack Query mutation hook; its `mutationFn` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })`.
- `web/src/connect.ts` — line 197 creates the client: `export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);` (generated types live in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`).
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` mapped to `POST /api/v1/memos` with `body: "memo"` (lines 21–27); generated Connect stubs in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.
- `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` — line 306, `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` unwraps the Connect request and delegates to the API service.
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — line 70, `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` authenticates the user, validates the UID and content length, rebuilds the memo payload, builds a `store.Memo`, then calls `s.Store.CreateMemo` (line 115).
- `store/memo.go` — line 109, `(*Store).CreateMemo` validates the UID against `base.UIDMatcher` and forwards to `s.driver.CreateMemo`.
- `store/driver.go` — declares `CreateMemo` on the `Driver` interface, which dispatches to the configured dialect.
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — line 16, `(*DB).CreateMemo` builds and executes the SQL: `INSERT INTO memo (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING id, created_ts, updated_ts, row_status` (line 41). The MySQL and Postgres equivalents are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`.
